start_server.description: Starts Jamulus in server mode. This is the fundamental switch for running a server.

port.description: The local UDP port to use for client connections. Default is 22124.

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support. If true, Jamulus listens on IPv6 addresses.

multithreading.description: Use multithreading to make better use of multi-core CPUs and support more clients.

max_channels.description: Set maximum number of channels (and therefore users). Default is 10, maximum is 150.

qos.description: Set QoS value (iptos byte) to use. Default is 128.

fast_update.description: Use 64 samples frame size mode to reduce latency if clients connect with 'enable small network buffers' turned on.

delay_panning.description: Start with delay panning enabled. Distributes audio based on latency.

notranslation.description: Disable translations, use built-in English strings.

welcome_message.description: Show message (may contain HTML and inline CSS) to users on connect.

require_licence.description: Require Clients to accept the agreement shown in the welcome message before they are allowed joining.

log_file.description: Enable logging to file. Leave empty to disable file logging.

recording_directory.description: Enable recording (but see --norecord) storing tracks in Directory. Leave empty to disable.

directory_server.description: Register the Server with the given Directory by setting the Directory Server Address. Use 'localhost' to be a Directory Server.

server_info.description: Set Server location details for registered servers, formatted as name;city;locale.

server_bind_ip.description: Configure Legacy IP address to bind to. Leave empty for all interfaces.

server_public_ip.description: Configure public legacy IP address when both the Directory Server and the actual Server are situated behind the same NAT.

jsonrpc_port.description: Enables JSON-RPC API server. Set to 0 to disable. Only accessible from localhost.

jsonrpc_secret_file.description: Path to a text file containing an authentication string for obtaining access to the JSON-RPC API. Required if jsonrpc_port is used.

inifile.description: Override default initialisation file. Typically used for client, but can influence server defaults.

htmlstatus_file.description: Write Server status and list of connected Clients, in HTML format, to file periodically. Leave empty to disable.
